title: Local and 2 local $\frac{1}{2}$-derivation of $n$-dimensional totally graded filiform Lie algebras
summary: This article provides a complete algebraic description of $\frac{1}{2}$-derivations, local $\frac{1}{2}$-derivations, and 2-local $\frac{1}{2}$-derivations on $n$-dimensional totally graded complex filiform Lie algebras of maximum length. Based on the foundational classification framework established by Janez Bernik (2020), we systematically determine the vector spaces of $\frac{1}{2}$-derivations for the six infinite structural sequences ($m_0(n)$, $m_2(n)$, $W^+(n)$, $m_{0,1}(n)$, $m_{0,2}(n)$, $m_{0,3}(n)$) and the five exceptional one-parameter families ($g_{7,α}$ through $g_{11,α}$).
